name: Maji Suki ~Marginal Skip~
source:
I didn't forget...

That night, under a bright moon.
I made a promise with a single girl.

That girl was...

One spring night, I met the girl again.
In order to meet again, the princess had run away from home.

That single girl, who was like a childhood friend.
She hadn't changed a bit; she still looked so young.
translation:
我没有忘记……

那个夜晚，明月高悬。
我与一名少女许下约定。

那名少女是……

一个春夜，我与她再次相逢。
为了这次重逢，公主从家中逃了出来。

她就像我的青梅竹马。
她一点也没有改变，看起来依然那么年幼。
